title: Algorithmic measurement procedures
reasoning: The paper discusses the theoretical limitations and formalization of measurement procedures using algorithms and Turing machines, drawing parallels to the halting problem. It delves into the philosophy of science and computation theory regarding what constitutes a valid measurement process. There is no component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. While 'paradox of foundation' is mentioned, it refers to the conceptual basis of measurement in science, not ethical dilemmas in the common sense.
